name: m2747-escape
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, Arabian desert in the 7th century, bright warm daylight, vibrant natural colours, high detail. The sun disc is NOT visible. No people, no faces, no text, no buildings. Seen from BEHIND at a distance: a single light-tan Arabian dromedary camel - exactly one hump, one head, four legs, natural proportions - wearing a North Arabian riding saddle: two inverted-Y shaped frames of pale tamarisk wood, one in front of the hump and one behind it, their upper arms rising above the hump and joined by side bars, with wool pads on both sides of the hump; hanging from the frame arms a pair of handwoven wool saddlebags striped red, black and cream with long black tassels below the belly, and one brown goatskin water skin; a dark brown plaited goat-hair rope halter around the muzzle and behind the ears with a long lead rope. The saddle is EMPTY - no rider. The camel trots away from the camera up the crest of a large dune toward the far horizon, saddlebags and water skin swaying, its lead rope trailing on the sand behind it. In the foreground, a line of fresh camel tracks in the sand leads away toward the camel.
